authentication: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict signed session cookie; Origin validation for writes

endpoints.GET /health: Public process readiness; 503 on unavailable initialized dependencies
endpoints.GET /api/snapshot: Snapshot; authenticated; refresh roughly every 2 seconds
endpoints.POST /api/scenario/control: {action:'pause'|'resume'|'reset',speed?:1|2|5} -> Snapshot; reset clears only current synthetic scenario, not media or agent definitions
endpoints.POST /api/interventions: {runId:string,recommendationId:string,actionId:ActionId} -> Intervention; only completed current-scenario recommendation; explicit human approval required
endpoints.POST /api/vision/analyze: 202 {requested:true}; request fresh sampled inference without generating fake observations
endpoints.GET /api/media/{cameraId}/{variant}.mp4: Authorized synthetic MP4 with byte-range support
endpoints.GET /api/vision/frames/{cameraId}.jpg: Authorized frame; observation query parameter requires exact image/observation match. X-Vitrine-Observation-Id response header must identify the bytes served. No arbitrary paths or unfenced latest-frame fallback.

provenanceRules: All source videos are original synthetic store footage, not real customer cameras.
POS and visitor/dwell metrics are explicitly simulated and never claimed as camera measurements.
Detections must come from actual RT-DETRv2 inference; raw simulator locations are evaluation-only.
Box coordinates are normalized xyxy for frameUri and sourceSeconds, not for arbitrary current video frames.
A failed inference has people:null and unavailable status, never a fake zero count.
No face identification, demographics, emotional state or cross-camera person identity.
Interventions change only simulated layout and simulated sales parameters; no demonstrated real-world causal uplift.
Agents are persisted named prompt agents invoked by agent_reference on the Foundry project Responses endpoint.
Simulation clock and frame timestamp are explicit; physical camera count and simulated conversion denominators are distinct.
